chunks.subject: AP Precalculus
chunks.title: Q2 — Periodic/Sinusoidal Modeling (6 points, calculator)
chunks.content: AP Precalculus FRQ 2 (Part A, graphing calculator required), 6 points, scored by lettered subparts. Q2 topic: periodic/sinusoidal function modeling (e.g., building a sinusoidal model f(x)=a·sin(b(x−c))+d from context, identifying amplitude/period/midline, evaluating, and interpreting). Points reward: correct sinusoidal parameters, correct evaluations/solutions with setup, and correct contextual interpretation. Common failure: wrong amplitude/period/midline; answer without setup; interpretation without context/units.
